orientation: PR-8 introduces the Bank.Modules.Statements module, providing monthly statement calculation (StatementService) and a GET API endpoint (StatementsController). It retrieves ledger entries to compute the opening balance, chronologically ordered statement lines with running balances, and closing balance for an account over a calendar month in UTC. The controller is secured for customer/staff access and maps domain exceptions to HTTP status codes.

findings.title: Inclusive upper bounds in ledger queries violate UTC month boundary exclusion
findings.claim: ledger.EntriesAsync evaluates ranges with inclusive upper bounds. Passing monthStart when retrieving prior entries causes entries at exactly YYYY-MM-01T00:00:00Z to be included in opening balance, while passing monthEnd causes entries at 00:00:00Z on the 1st of the next month to be included in the current month's lines. This violates strict month boundary criteria and causes boundary tests to fail.
findings.requirement_link: Month boundaries are strictly UTC: include entries with timestamp >= YYYY-MM-01T00:00:00Z and < (YYYY-MM-01 + 1 month)T00:00:00Z; entries at exactly 00:00:00Z on the 1st of the next month belong to the next month and are excluded.
findings.suggested_fix: Filter priorEntries with .Where(e => e.CreatedAt < monthStart) and monthEntries with .Where(e => e.CreatedAt >= monthStart && e.CreatedAt < monthEnd) so that midnight UTC boundary entries are strictly excluded as required.

findings.claim: StatementsController is completely uncovered by tests. The requirement acceptance criteria explicitly specify endpoint routing, [Authorize(Policy = Policies.Customer)], 401 for unauthenticated calls, and exception-to-HTTP-status mappings (400, 404, 403), none of which are validated by any unit or integration tests.
findings.requirement_link: Expose GET api/accounts/{id}/statements/{year}/{month} on a controller decorated with [ApiController] and [Authorize(Policy = Policies.Customer)], returning HTTP 200 OK with the Statement payload.
findings.suggested_fix: Add controller unit or integration tests verifying that GET api/accounts/{id}/statements/{year}/{month} returns 200 OK for valid requests, 401 for unauthenticated calls, 403 when forbidden, 404 on missing account, and 400 on invalid calendar inputs.

findings.title: Tautological assertion recalculates running balance over returned lines without checking expected line order
findings.claim: The test re-computes running balances by looping over the returned statement.Lines array in whatever sequence the service returned them. Because two transactions share the identical timestamp (10:00:00), an arbitrary or reversed ordering would still pass the assertion loop without verifying expected transaction sequence or reference order.
findings.requirement_link: Lines are ordered chronologically by At ascending, and each line's BalanceAfter equals the prior balance plus that line's signed Amount, rounded to 2 decimal places with MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero.
findings.suggested_fix: Assert expected line references, individual amounts, and explicit BalanceAfter values for statement.Lines[0], statement.Lines[1], and statement.Lines[2] directly rather than looping and recalculating.
